mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN release_time >= #{begin} AND release_time < #{endBefore} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS released, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'COMPLETED' AND finish_time >= #{begin} AND finish_time < #{endBefore} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completed, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'COMPLETED' AND finish_time >= #{begin} AND finish_time < #{endBefore} AND plan_end IS NOT NULL AND CAST(finish_time AS DATE) <= plan_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completed_on_time, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'COMPLETED' AND finish_time >= #{begin} AND finish_time < #{endBefore} THEN qty ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completed_plan_qty, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'COMPLETED' AND finish_time >= #{begin} AND finish_time < #{endBefore} THEN finished_qty ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completed_finished_qty FROM mes_work_order WHERE (release_time >= #{begin} AND release_time < #{endBefore}) OR (finish_time >= #{begin} AND finish_time < #{endBefore})

SELECT COUNT(*) AS reports, COALESCE(SUM(good_qty), 0) AS good_qty, COALESCE(SUM(scrap_qty), 0) AS scrap_qty, COALESCE(SUM(hours), 0) AS hours FROM mes_report WHERE report_date >= #{begin} AND report_date <= #{end}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mes_work_order WHERE status IN ('RELEASED', 'STARTED')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mes_work_order WHERE status IN ('RELEASED', 'STARTED') AND plan_end < #{today}
